name: TryAMM Asset Forge Credit Pricing
principle: Search and reuse authorized Asset Vault items first. Generate a new asset only when reuse or adaptation is not suitable. All generation requires a preflight quote, credit authorization, provider-cost record and minimum-margin gate.

creditReference.note: This is a customer-facing reference for quoting, not a promise of fixed compute value. CostOps may adjust debit amounts when upstream provider, compute, storage, payment or support costs change.

meshyAssetOffers.name: AI 3D Asset Generation — Standard
meshyAssetOffers.pricingRule: 180 credits is a starting quote only. Before execution CostOps must ensure actual provider+compute+storage+payment+support+reserve cost is covered with configured contribution margin.

meshyAssetOffers.name: AI Character + Rig Pipeline
meshyAssetOffers.pricingRule: Quote dynamically based on generation, retopology, rigging, textures and validation steps.

meshyAssetOffers.name: Production Asset Pipeline
meshyAssetOffers.pricingRule: Quote dynamically for higher-quality generation plus optimization, LODs, collision, rig/animation where requested, Digital DNA, validation and export derivatives.

reuseDiscount.rule: If an owned or properly licensed asset can be reused or adapted, quote the lower-cost adaptation pipeline instead of charging for unnecessary full regeneration.
reuseDiscount.benefit: Reduces provider spend, increases margin and grows the value of the Asset Vault.

executionRule: No external generation provider may be called until the quote is accepted and credits are authorized. On completion settle against actual cost; release unused authorization or clearly disclose any additional authorization required before extra work.
failureRule: Provider failure must not silently consume the full customer charge. Apply retry/refund/re-credit rules based on completed billable work and provider recovery.
